body:
We should make sure we have support for greetings of users with hi/hello or greetings stickers, like we did in https://github.com/konard/vk-bot

As initiation of dialog, can be one of the time consuming operations, so it would be possible to save time, and have something to start, so user can test his next people talking strategy.

We should support it in VK, Telegram and other systems we already support. We also should try to do the same in x, whatsapp, zalo, and others.

In telegram for example we should try to use the same default greeting stickers, that are possible to use when dialog is empty, and also other greeting stickers (which user should be able to select and see in the UI), we should not import any graphics file in our repository, but we can store direct links to them.

If not possible to collect in advance, we should use API to list them.
title: Support greetings stickers
